positions.as_written: Measure the passive extension and flexion with the patient relaxed and the limb supported.
Assess the hip, since a hip flexion contracture produces an apparent knee flexion contracture in standing.
A contracture in a knee with a chronically effused joint has a cause that must be addressed, and releasing without addressing it recurs.
